slides.title:
How I'd explain
~ChatGPT~
to a 5-year-old
slides.sub:
12 ideas from one school day.
The real prompt under each.

cells.kid: Ask your teacher a clear question and you get a clear answer. Mumble and you get a guess.
cells.sql: Prompt: "SQL for total sales by city"

cells.kid: Tell the shopkeeper the gift is for your sister's birthday, and he picks something better.
Show your little brother one solved sum. Now he can do the next one himself.
A friend who tells a confident story about a film he never watched.
Count your change after buying sweets, even from the nicest shopkeeper.
Low: the same bedtime story every night. High: a new twist each time.
Grandpa explaining an old family recipe, one step at a time.
cells.sql: Prompt: "Explain this formula line by line"

cells.kid: Mum sorting a pile of mixed-up socks into neat pairs.
cells.sql: Prompt: "Trim spaces, fix case in column A"

cells.kid: Asking the class topper how he solved it, then trying it yourself.
You never shout your home address across the playground.
cells.sql: Remove names and phone numbers first

cells.kid: Eating a big laddoo in small bites, not all at once.
A calculator helps with sums. You still decide what to add.
cells.sql: AI drafts. You check. You decide.
